# <Department> Charter

## Mission
One sentence.

## Owns
Responsibilities and artifacts this department is accountable for.

## Does not own

## Interfaces
- **Consumes:** contract types / ports it depends on.
- **Provides:** public API (`legalai_<dept>.__all__`) and the ports it implements.

## Quality bars

## Reliability duties
